timePolicy: All merchant display, entry and recurrence use Kenya time; timed commitments persist as UTC instants and local dates remain dates. No timezone picker.
bindingPolicy: Profile plus offering plus explicit answers selects models. Instantiating a reservation requires a command and confirmed authority. A definition or condition does not itself create work or grant permission.

models.calendar: order queue and hours; fulfilment windows only after explicit activation
models.allocationRule: Never create a staff/asset appointment for ordinary product purchase. A selected scheduled delivery or collection uses a separately enabled typed window capability.
models.evidenceNeeded: Order-only profile works without Payload reservation; explicitly selected extra services instantiate once and link to the order.

models.capacityUnit: one appointment or explicit group size
models.calendar: staff/resource day and week with agenda
models.allocationRule: Reserve all required staff/space/equipment together. Walk-ins consume the same underlying resources. Remote method does not require a fictitious physical room.
models.evidenceNeeded: Simultaneous overlap fails correctly; failed reschedule retains original; optional booking remains distinct from mandatory booking.

models.capacityUnit: team time and declared service workload
customerFlow: submit or choose feasible arrival window
models.allocationRule: Travel and coverage constrain feasible intervals. Enabling home service never automatically creates a linked visit until that method is selected.
models.evidenceNeeded: Out-of-area or infeasible travel blocks confirmation; no partial team allocation and no duplicate child visit.

resources: driver if explicitly requested and appropriate
models.calendar: multi-day asset timeline and handover/return agenda
models.allocationRule: Use exact half-open intervals plus turnaround; maintenance blocks the same asset. With-driver allocation stays rental and consumes both resources together.
models.evidenceNeeded: Multi-day overlap/extension/maintenance tests, midnight boundaries, retained old allocation on failed extension.

resources: greeter only for a declared greeter-only offering
models.capacityUnit: trip resource time and permitted passenger/luggage capacity
customerFlow: provide pickup/dropoff and relevant flight information
receive confirmed assignment or pending request
models.allocationRule: Vehicle and driver allocations are joint when transport is included. Flight changes propose a change rather than silently moving an agreed booking.
models.evidenceNeeded: Busy driver prevents trip without leaving vehicle held; greeter-only service requires no invented vehicle.

models.capacityUnit: places per actual occurrence and ticket class constraints
requiredSetup: series and exception rule if recurring
customerFlow: review actual remaining capacity and terms
receive confirmed places and supported ticket/check-in reference
models.allocationRule: Ticket types cannot independently oversell a shared session. Recurrence creates actual occurrences with separate state; an exclusive instructor commitment must not prevent multiple attendees joining the same occurrence.
models.evidenceNeeded: Final-place race, holds expiry, same-session versus cross-session resource occupancy, recurring exception and pass-scope coverage.

models.capacityUnit: party size and exclusive space interval
models.allocationRule: Seated capacity alone is not a table map. Declaring an existing reservation system does not enable table booking or transfer authority. Combined tables reserve together.
models.evidenceNeeded: Party-size fit, overlapping table combination, external system declaration without enablement, safe change.

models.capacityUnit: places per departure plus explicit private intervals
customerFlow: receive confirmed controlled and supplier allocations
models.allocationRule: Private and shared offerings use the same underlying resources. Supplier accommodation/park/transport inclusions are not local available inventory without confirmed authority.
models.evidenceNeeded: Shared/private capacity conflict, guide-language eligibility, multi-day boundaries and pending supplier confirmation.

resources: specialist equipment or team if controlled
models.capacityUnit: declared production units and due windows
payloadReuse: reservation allocation for exact compatible windows
models.allocationRule: A due date is not the start of a 60-minute appointment. Preserve accepted specifications; changes recalculate feasibility and price.
models.evidenceNeeded: Too-short lead time rejected; capacity oversubscription blocked; sourcing is not manufacture; delivery/fitting created only if selected.

resources: actual fulfillment resources only after scope/authority confirmation
models.capacityUnit: none for request; selected model units at commitment
models.calendar: request queue and clearly tentative milestones
payloadReuse: reservation primitives for the later approved resource allocation only
customerFlow: receive confirmed service only after authority/resource confirmation
models.allocationRule: Submitting a request is not a hold, supplier booking, financial transaction or approved application. Confirmed child work uses a supported model once.
models.evidenceNeeded: Request leaves capacity unchanged; supplier pending remains visible; duplicate acceptance does not create duplicate work.

requiredSetup: coverage and transport capacity if selected
models.allocationRule: Collection, processing and return must be feasible together. Customer drop-off mode has no invented rider allocation.
models.evidenceNeeded: Infeasible return rejected, shared capacity counted once, no duplicate collection/return children.

models.capacityUnit: job workload or explicit resource interval
requiredSetup: promised completion distinct from visit time
models.calendar: job queue and optional technician/bay calendar
customerFlow: submit job or select offered slot
receive job progress and actual completion promise
models.allocationRule: Do not turn a repair completion estimate or walk-in queue position into a confirmed appointment; preserve actual capacity shared with scheduled work.
models.evidenceNeeded: Queue versus booked mode honored, assessment authorization retained, unbookable job cannot consume fabricated provider slot.

resources: actual session/provider only on separate booking
models.capacityUnit: declared access/visit credit, distinct from places
models.calendar: access/plan view linked to actual sessions
payloadReuse: reservation primitives for separately booked sessions
models.allocationRule: Plan purchase does not reserve every future class. Credit use and resource reservation must not diverge on retry or failure. Recurrence alone does not authorize a plan or recurring charge.
models.evidenceNeeded: Expired entitlement blocks restricted access; plan alone consumes no slot; repeated booking command uses credit once.

payloadReuse: resources and compatible interval allocations only
models.allocationRule: Weight, volume and container quantities are distinct constraints. Do not treat them as interchangeable guestCount. Fleet count is not proof of available truck or carrier space.
models.evidenceNeeded: Unit mismatch and oversized cargo rejected, carrier pending visible, route/leg failure does not invent delivered status.

resources: identified storage unit or typed capacity pool
models.calendar: occupancy timeline with distinct handling appointments
payloadReuse: resources and compatible flexible interval allocations
customerFlow: request compatible storage quantity and dates
models.allocationRule: Typed pool capacity must hold across the entire interval. An access visit is not a new storage booking. No implicit sqm/sqft conversion or rounding.
models.evidenceNeeded: Overlapping pool consumption respects actual units, extension cannot evict another commitment, handling visits do not double-count occupancy.
